name: Bell 47 Flyable Helicopter (EFM)
summary: Freeware flyable Bell 47 light helicopter with EFM, updated for DCS World 2.9.
description:
Flyable Bell 47 with an external flight model, cold start, night-vision goggles (N), flashlight (LAlt+L), pilot and copilot seats (1 and 2), and a door gunner who fires where the pilot looks once you click "Cleared To Fire".

Version 2.0 is built for DCS 2.9 and fixes the inverted control-stick animation. The gunner seat isn't selectable, and the floats are for show: it can't land on water.

The download on ED User Files is a small zip that points to the full mod.

releases.changelog: Updated for DCS 2.9. Fixed the inverted control-stick animation.
